tagline: Butterfly pea tea in a practical teabag format from Setu, South Tangerang.
eyebrow: Butterfly Pea Flower Tea · Setu · Tangerang Selatan

story.title: A blue-flower tea with a verifiable local product profile.
story.body: Rumah Kurasi Tangerang Selatan lists Our Herb as a Setu-based beverage product made from butterfly pea flower in teabag form, with stated production capacity of 200 boxes. The page keeps the product story factual and avoids turning general botanical associations into medical claims.
